children: Solidion Technology Inc. (STI) filed a Form 8K - Other Events - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 21, 2026.

Effective September 16, 2026, the Company appointed Mark N. Schwartz, a Director on the Board, to serve as Lead Independent Director, and Jaymes Winters, the Company's Chief Executive Officer and a Director on the Board, to also serve as Chairman of the Board.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1881551/000121390026101539/ea0306024-8k_solidion.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1881551/000121390026101539/0001213900-26-101539-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
